title: Mirror Cartographer identity is stable while descriptive frames evolve

source_classes.observation: The canonical project field is Mirror Cartographer.
Project continuity is defined as a provenance-linked project self rather than any single account, thread, deployment, or snapshot.
The project is named Mirror Cartographer and described there as a recursive symbolic cognition interface.
The same project name is paired with a broader description centered on human-centered AI reflection, symbolic emotional mapping, and meaningful interaction.

Earlier copied project material uses the same project name while describing forms, worksheets, symbolic mapping, prompt engines, and future interfaces. Exact original-message metadata is not restored by the copy.

observed: Mirror Cartographer is the stable project identity across the inspected canonical repository state and multiple project artifacts.

The project's descriptions vary across artifacts, including symbolic emotional self-mapping tool, recursive symbolic cognition interface, human-centered AI reflection system, engine, atlas, and continuity architecture.
Repository continuity rules require copied or derived material to remain qualified by source class and privacy boundary.
inferred: The variation is best modeled as evolution of scope, implementation, and explanatory frame rather than repeated project renaming.
Treating every descriptive shift as an identity change would create false contradictions and fragment the project graph.
proposed: Future lexicon records should classify each term as identity, description, implementation, metaphor, or superseded label.
Interfaces should display the stable project identity separately from the currently active descriptive frame.
superseded: The interpretation that changing descriptions necessarily mean the project changed names.
unresolved: The complete dated sequence of all descriptive frames has not yet been reconstructed.
Some source material exists only as copied exports, so original timestamps and message boundaries remain partially unavailable.
No canonical machine-readable language lexicon currently links every descriptive frame to first-known use and later reinterpretation.

operational_decision.rule: Preserve project identity independently from descriptions, implementations, metaphors, deployments, repositories, and account containers.
operational_decision.contradiction_handling: When descriptions conflict, retain both with dates and source classes; resolve whether the conflict is semantic, temporal, implementation-level, or factual before marking either superseded.

privacy_boundary: Public-safe abstraction only. No raw private transcript, health information, credentials, personal identifiers, or sensitive uploaded passages are reproduced.
